newsitem.title: USA: McDermott probing non-US work irregularities.
newsitem.headline: McDermott probing non-US work irregularities.

text.p: McDermott International Inc, in a statement released Tuesday detailing a conference call yesterday afternoon, said an investigation into alleged wrongdoing by former employees will focus on supposed irregularities in obtaining work outside the United States.
But the company, whose investigation is looking at former employees of both McDermott International and J. Ray McDermott, said it would not limit itself to just those allegations.
The company did not comment further on the investigation.
In addition, Tetrault outlined a four point plan to return McDermott International and J. Ray McDermott to profitability and to improve the companies' value to shareholders.
As announced yesterday, J. Ray McDermott expects to report a net loss for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 of $60 to $70 million.
